purpose.domain_detail: Compensation/billing statement processing for insurance carriers; handles billing statements, refund vouchers, barcodes, and remittance for accounts with various bill/remit codes (B, S, T, E, R). References compensation master, CID, mail room, and financial responsibility numbers.
purpose.summary: CIB007 reads billing statement print lines created by program EL562 and routes them to multiple output files based on bill/remit code (B, S, T, E, R). It adds barcodes and cover letters to statements destined for mailing, and generates cash disbursement vouchers for refund accounts. It also produces extract files for CSR reporting and downstream processing.

notable_features: Multiple output files (9+ SELECT entries) for different statement types
VSAM indexed file access (ERCOMP, FORMDEFS) with DYNAMIC access
Extensive change log spanning 2000-2018 with change request numbers
LINE SEQUENTIAL organization for KEYS-EXT extract file
